title: Jerusalem Artichoke and Root Vegetable Soup
subtitle: with crispy root chips
description: A smooth, buttery-tasting soup of Jerusalem artichoke and root vegetables with no butter or cream, topped with crisp vegetable chips and spring garlic.

steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a pot and fry the chopped onions, leeks and garlic over medium heat for about 5 minutes until fragrant. Add 2 kg peeled, thinly sliced Jerusalem artichoke, the celeriac and 2 of the parsley roots (peeled and roughly chopped) and cook for about 10 minutes.
Add the white wine, sea salt, thyme leaves and chopped sage and cook for about 10 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock (or water) and the parmesan rind wrapped in a cloth bag, bring to the boil, reduce the heat and cook for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Remove the parmesan rind and blend everything with a stick blender or food processor until smooth. Add the juice of the lemon and adjust the seasoning.

Make the root chips: heat oil for deep frying and fry the remaining Jerusalem artichoke, the celery and the remaining parsley root, all peeled and sliced thinly with a peeler, in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden. Drain on paper towel, season with salt and cool.
Ladle the soup into bowls and serve with the root chips and the sliced spring garlic that has been soaked in 4 tbsp olive oil.
